title: Part attributes: Design Type, Source, Safety Classification, Item Property

blocks.text: Design Type, Safety Classification and Item Property are Part attributes and filters, not trees. Source is a cross-cutting facet.

Product scope, location, function and source shall be separate dimensions, each recorded as its own facet. The kind of design work is recorded as the Design Type attribute of a Part (1.10), not as a facet.

Modified bought-in items. A bought-in item that is modified in-house shall be recorded as a new Part with Source Make, and shall carry a Derived from link (2I.2) to the bought-in source Part. A change to the source Part shall flag the modified Part for review. A modified bought-in Part shall keep the Design Type Bought-in Equipment, and with it the TSMs of that Design Type, and shall also record the Design Type of the modification (for example Metallic - Machined), whose TSMs it shall also bring to its FDPS (6B.5).

Design Type (the kind of design work, for example a material or process kind) shall be an attribute of every Part, with its permitted values held in a value register. Catalogue items (Source Standard Part) shall take the Design Type Standard Part, so that they reach the TSMs tagged with it (6B.5).

Safety Classification shall be an attribute of a Part, with its permitted values held in a value register. A Part used in several places (for example a standard fastener) shall take the highest Safety Classification required by any of its uses. The software shall flag a Part whose classification is lower than that required by any use, for reassignment by a person (0.5).

Property values. Item properties under 4.1 shall be recorded as structured attributes of the Part, drawn from a value register, and may be used to filter considerations and checklists. The item property Fastener shall mark the Parts whose Part Instances require a Secures link (1.6.6). The software shall flag any Part Instance of a Fastener Part that has no Secures link, and any Part Instance with a Secures link whose Part is not a Fastener Part.
